name: deal-to-client-slack-channel

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The Notion DEALS database automation (deal stage change) and/or the Deals 'Create Slack Channel' button property POST the deal page here. `webhook_url` is the one external systems call; `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal.

notion.note: Pages are read and written with sdk.fetch against the Notion REST API, matching the rest of this repo. Guard + write-back property: Companies 'Slack Channel ID' (rich_text); the 'Slack Channel' property is now a FORMULA rendering the URL from it, so the id is the only write.

tables.01JM3J9SG5X6S8GBSSC8AS28AT: [Table] Internal User IDs — Notion user id (f6) -> Slack user id (f3), for inviting the deal owner. A missing mapping throws (config gap, not a skip).
tables.01JM8PH8YM93A482M8BFZ6WKW6: [Table] Company IDs — NOT read or written by this workflow. The classic Zap's find-or-create + guard queried it; the durable guards on the Notion page property instead, and notion-companies-to-zapier-table mirrors the id into the Table.

ai_model.why: Shortening a company name to a slug is a trivial generation task; Standard matched the intent on every verified case and the workflow deterministically re-enforces all naming rules afterwards (normalizeChannelName), so tier only affects word choice.

replaces_classic_zap: Create Client Slack Channel from Notion

cutover.notion_sender_repointed: PENDING — repoint the Notion Deals automation/button that POSTs to the classic Zap's catch URL to webhook_url above
cutover.classic_zap_disabled: PENDING — classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector; disable in the Zapier UI

description: Deal webhook from Notion -> AI-shortened 'deal-*' Slack channel for the company, channel id written back to the Company, deal owner invited unless it's Dennis (whose connection created the channel).
